messages:
Ava (customer-success): Harrowside just opened a ticket — they see p99 jump from ~350ms to ~2.4s and some 429s since 10:15 UTC. Said it started when they kicked off a nightly indexing job. Can we triage?
Priya (support): Thanks, looping Eng-oncall. Any request ids or example spans from their traces?
Harrowside Ops: attaching a few request ids, all on the text-gen endpoint: req=hh-1001, hh-1006, hh-1010. We're on Dedicated-us-east, region us-east-2. Frontend shows retries and some user-facing latency alerts.
Sam (eng-oncall): looking now. I can see p50 ~40ms, p95 ~780ms, p99 ~2.4s for harrowside on node pool gpux-prod-4 between 10:12-10:25. There are long queue times on their lane and increased interleaving.
Jun (infra): digging infra metrics — node gpunode-42 has high context-switches and GPU memory churn. Kv-cache hit-rate for that tenant dropped from 98% -> 45% around the spike window. Looks like a concurrent heavy batch embedding job is thrashing KV loads.
Priya (support): customer says the batch is large (200k docs) and they don't have rate-limits on that job. Can we do something quick to stop user-facing errors while we investigate?
Sam (eng-oncall): short-term mitigation options: (1) ephemeral reservation/allowlist to give Harrowside dedicated capacity for a few hours, (2) throttle the batch job (we can ask customer to reduce concurrency), (3) fallback route: pin smaller model variant (faster tokens) for user-facing traffic.
Jun (infra): I can add them to a temporary priority lane for 6h. That will reserve N slots and prevent cross-tenant queue preemption. Creating reservation now.
deploy-bot: Reservation created: id=resv-9876 tenant=harrowside duration=6h priority=high created_by=jun
Harrowside Ops: Appreciate the fast move, please confirm when in effect so we can pause our batch if needed.
Sam (eng-oncall): It should take effect immediately for new requests. Also enabling smoother KV cache eviction policy on that pool (less aggressive) to stabilize cache hit-rate.
Priya (support): I told the customer to pause the heavy batch for 30m while we verify.
Ava (customer-success): Customer confirmed they paused the batch. Initial metrics: p95 dropped from 780ms -> 120ms within 4 minutes, p99 down to ~220ms. They report no frontend 429s now. :tada:
Jun (infra): Logged an incident and linked the node diagnostic bundle: /internal/logs/node/gpunode-42/1746789000.tar.gz. Recommending long-term: dedicated reserved pool or autoscale rule that shards large batch jobs to a separate bucket.
Sam (eng-oncall): Agreed. Action items: 1) create a short RFC for tenant reservation quotas (owner: jun), 2) add an automated detection rule for KV-cache thrash (owner: sam), 3) docs + customer playbook for large batch jobs (owner: ava). I'll open infra ticket for gpunode-42 noisy neighbor investigation.
Harrowside Ops: Thanks team, this resolved the immediate pain. We'll test re-run offline and coordinate with you before resuming heavy jobs.
Priya (support): Closing this Slack thread for now; will watch the alert channel for any regressions. Ping if it returns and we'll escalate to oncall 2.
Sam (eng-oncall): Note: if customer needs >6h we should convert to a reservation contract or suggest Dedicated capacity purchase.
Ava (customer-success): Adding follow-up meeting with Harrowside tomorrow to review best practices. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
